bias.label: Leaning down below 3,595-3,607; bigger trend down

event: Wed 25 Nov 15:30 SAST: US October PCE inflation, durable goods and Q3 GDP. Wed 21:00 SAST: Fed Beige Book. Thu 26 Nov: Thanksgiving, US markets shut. Fed decision Wed 9 Dec.

bullets.title: Quiet in Asia
bullets.text: Gold was about 3,564 in early Asian trade on Wednesday, a small bounce after Tuesday closed at 3,555.82; the exact quote time is UNVERIFIED.

bullets.title: Big Tuesday drop
bullets.text: Gold fell about 2.2% on Tuesday after strong US consumer confidence, and silver fell over 5%.

bullets.title: Hike nearly priced
bullets.text: CME FedWatch shows about 97% odds of a 25 bp Fed hike on 9 December and roughly 66-70% odds of one more by January.

bullets.title: Dollar eased slightly
bullets.text: The dollar index slipped 0.48% to 103.82 on Tuesday but stays near a 20-month high, so it is still a headwind.

bullets.title: Key floor below
bullets.text: FXEmpire says a sustained break under 3,527 (50% of the long-term range) would open deeper losses.

bullets.title: PCE today
bullets.text: PCE, GDP and durable goods at 15:30 SAST are today's big test, and Thanksgiving on Thursday will thin trading.

levels.note: Friday's 14-month low 3,513.54 (Reuters); FXEmpire lists last week's low as 3,502.99
